import subprocess
from unittest.mock import patch, MagicMock
import typer

def test_launch_wait_false():
    with patch("typer.main._is_macos", return_value=False), \
         patch("typer.main._is_linux_or_bsd", return_value=True), \
         patch("shutil.which", return_value="/usr/bin/xdg-open"), \
         patch("subprocess.Popen") as mock_popen:
        
        mock_process = MagicMock()
        mock_popen.return_value = mock_process
        
        # Case: wait=False
        result = typer.launch("http://example.com", wait=False)
        assert result == 0
        mock_process.wait.assert_not_called()
        print("test_launch_wait_false passed")

def test_launch_wait_true():
    with patch("typer.main._is_macos", return_value=False), \
         patch("typer.main._is_linux_or_bsd", return_value=True), \
         patch("shutil.which", return_value="/usr/bin/xdg-open"), \
         patch("subprocess.Popen") as mock_popen:
        
        mock_process = MagicMock()
        mock_process.wait.return_value = 0
        mock_popen.return_value = mock_process
        
        # Case: wait=True
        result = typer.launch("http://example.com", wait=True)
        assert result == 0
        mock_process.wait.assert_called_once()
        print("test_launch_wait_true passed")

def test_launch_macos_wait_false():
    with patch("typer.main._is_macos", return_value=True), \
         patch("subprocess.Popen") as mock_popen:
        
        mock_process = MagicMock()
        mock_popen.return_value = mock_process
        
        # Case: wait=False
        result = typer.launch("http://example.com", wait=False)
        assert result == 0
        mock_process.wait.assert_not_called()
        print("test_launch_macos_wait_false passed")

def test_launch_macos_wait_true():
    with patch("typer.main._is_macos", return_value=True), \
         patch("subprocess.Popen") as mock_popen:
        
        mock_process = MagicMock()
        mock_process.wait.return_value = 0
        mock_popen.return_value = mock_process
        
        # Case: wait=True
        result = typer.launch("http://example.com", wait=True)
        assert result == 0
        mock_process.wait.assert_called_once()
        print("test_launch_macos_wait_true passed")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_launch_wait_false()
    test_launch_wait_true()
    test_launch_macos_wait_false()
    test_launch_macos_wait_true()
    print("All tests passed!")
